method: Per PLAN §1.1 and the inventory audit_note: rank/feature comparison of every proposal against every forbidden row on five features (information source, decision clock, conditioning variable, holding, direction rule); rename/invert/re-clock test; rescue-clause scan; control causality (non-strawman) check; outcome-blind attestation check; macro-flag consistency check; cross-proposal duplicate check. A proposal is INELIGIBLE if any forbidden row's operative information source and conditioning survive in it as a renamed, sign-inverted or re-clocked variant (operationalized: the row's observable appears in the proposal, possibly transformed), or if any rescue clause fires.

F1_v1_family1.mechanism: London-open momentum continuation at intraday clocks
F1_v1_family1.source: price session structure (session-open move, free G10 bid/mid)

F2_v1_family2.mechanism: late-NY standardized-extension fade at intraday clocks

F4_v2_family2.mechanism: London-AM range break with retest-hold confirmation
F4_v2_family2.source: price session structure (AM range break + retest)

FXFV3-A4-P1.title: Post-availability drift in the direction of a policy-rate change
FXFV3-A4-P1.source: macro vintage series (BIS WS_CBPOL change events, availability-gated); prices only for fills/PnL
FXFV3-A4-P1.clock: daily 16:00-NY, event-driven (decisions only on newly-eligible change events)
FXFV3-A4-P1.direction_rule: sign of the rate change (hike long / cut short the area's currency); no price input to direction

FXFV3-A4-P2.title: Policy-rate differential divergence trend at a weekly clock
FXFV3-A4-P2.source: macro vintage series (BIS WS_CBPOL as-of differential)
FXFV3-A4-P2.clock: weekly (Wednesday 16:00-NY; holiday => whole-week NO_TRADE, never re-clocked)
FXFV3-A4-P2.conditioning: sign of 26-week change in the availability-gated policy-rate differential
FXFV3-A4-P2.holding: 1 week (5 sessions) with zero-trade roll while direction unchanged
FXFV3-A4-P2.direction_rule: sign(d(T) - d(T-26w)); level => NO_TRADE; carry-adjacent disclosed (change not level)

FXFV3-A5-P1.title: Policy-divergence-gated daily trend
FXFV3-A5-P1.source: daily price trend (21d) for direction + macro vintage drift (63d) as gate
FXFV3-A5-P1.conditioning: strict sign agreement of m(21d) and g(63d differential drift)
FXFV3-A5-P1.holding: multi-day state persistence (exit on sign flip)
FXFV3-A5-P1.direction_rule: continuation of the pair's own daily trend, gated by macro drift agreement

FXFV3-A5-P2.title: Daily panel-outlier reversal in a high-dispersion state
FXFV3-A5-P2.conditioning: HIGH-dispersion state (panel sd > trailing 126d median) + panel z threshold |z|>1

FXFV3-A6-P1.title: Realized-vol regime-gated policy-rate-differential carry
FXFV3-A6-P1.source: macro vintage differential level (direction) + own realized range (gate)
FXFV3-A6-P1.conditioning: LOW-vol state (20d block mean vs median of 10 prior blocks; no tuned threshold)
FXFV3-A6-P1.holding: state-driven multi-day (exit on HIGH state or differential sign flip)
FXFV3-A6-P1.direction_rule: sign of the differential LEVEL (carry direction), vol-gated; carry-adjacent disclosed

FXFV3-A6-P2.title: Cross-pair information diffusion: leave-one-out basket lead-lag
FXFV3-A6-P2.source: daily 16:00-NY closes, cross-pair (leave-one-out mean of other 6 pairs)
FXFV3-A6-P2.conditioning: none (always-on sign of the LOO lead)
FXFV3-A6-P2.direction_rule: continuation of the cross-pair common-factor lead

pairwise_feature_comparison.note: distinct_features counts how many of the 5 features differ in kind between the proposal and the forbidden row. 'PARTIAL direction-class' = only the abstract continuation/fade class is shared; the operative object and horizon differ. Ineligibility requires the row's operative observable (intraday session geometry) to survive in the proposal; no pair meets that.

FXFV3-A4-P1.shared_features: none (all five features differ in kind; direction is macro-signed, not price-signed)

FXFV3-A4-P2.shared_features: none (weekly clock, macro conditioning, one-week holding, macro-signed direction)

FXFV3-A5-P1.shared_features: vs_F1 direction-rule class only: both are 'continuation', but F1 continues the session-open move at an intraday clock while A5-P1 continues the pair's own 21-day daily trend gated by macro drift; F1's observable (session-open behavior) appears nowhere

FXFV3-A5-P2.shared_features: vs_F2 direction-rule class only: both 'fade an extension', but F2 fades the standardized LATE-SESSION extension at an intraday clock while A5-P2 fades the 5-day panel-relative return outlier at a daily clock under a dispersion-state gate; F2's observable (session geometry) appears nowhere

FXFV3-A6-P1.shared_features: none (direction from differential LEVEL gated by a daily vol state; no session structure anywhere)

FXFV3-A6-P2.shared_features: direction-rule class only vs F1/F3/F4: both 'continuation', but the forbidden rows continue session-structure moves at intraday clocks while A6-P2 continues the leave-one-out cross-pair daily mean; none of the forbidden rows is a cross-pair lead-lag construction

pairwise_feature_comparison.rename_invert_reclock_test: No proposal contains any forbidden row's operative observable. Source and clock differ in kind for all 24 proposal-row pairs (macro-vintage or daily-grain cross-sectional price vs intraday session structure). Sign inversion: no proposal trades an inverted forbidden signal (A4-P1's internal sign-flip arm is a preregistered causal control that can only add falsification, never a rescue). Re-clock: the inventory's re-clock guard targets intraday->nearby-clock moves of the same signal; moving to the ex-ante frozen daily-or-slower rule with a different observable is not a re-clock.

rescue_clause_scan.clock_rule: All six decision clocks are daily or slower (event-driven daily, weekly, or daily 16:00-NY) per baseline_invariants v3_decision_clock and PLAN §2; no intraday decision clock anywhere. Compliant, and chosen ex ante by the frozen invariant, not outcome-driven.
rescue_clause_scan.cost_rule: All six use the frozen 1.5 bps/side base with tiers {1.0,1.5,2.0} -> 1.5/2.25/3.0 bps/side, F1-fixed application to BOOKED stress PnL via book_stress, delay stress carried unblended, break-even diagnostic explicitly never a fee rescue. No lower fee assumptions anywhere.
rescue_clause_scan.pair_subsets: None; all six trade the full frozen 7-pair universe with explicit no-ex-ante-subsetting justifications; concentration/USD-drift/drop-one gates handle heterogeneity ex post.
rescue_clause_scan.sign_inversion_of_rejected_families: None as a trading rule. A4-P1's control is the only sign flip and it is internal, preregistered, and falsifying.
rescue_clause_scan.session_relabeling: None; no proposal uses a session label or session window in any decision.
rescue_clause_scan.threshold_relaxation: None of a forbidden row: A5-P2's z=1.0 and A6-P1's median split are thresholds on NEW observables, not relaxed parameters of session-structure rows.
rescue_clause_scan.regrading_or_result_aware_reuse: None; all six are fresh blind packets with new hypothesis_ids and independent designs (A6 discloses reading V2 predecessor packets for novelty differentiation only — mechanism knowledge, permitted; no outcome artifacts).
rescue_clause_scan.verdict: PASS for all six; no rescue operation fires.

cross_proposal_duplicates.duplicate_verdict: No two proposals are the same mechanism in different clothes. Closest adjacencies are recorded as genus overlaps (MEDIUM, non-binding) below.

genus_overlaps_non_binding.genus: policy-rate-differential-conditioned (all three read the same adopted BIS WS_CBPOL differential ingredient: A4-P2 direction=26w drift; A5-P1 gate=63d drift; A6-P1 direction=level)
genus_overlaps_non_binding.why_not_duplicates: Direction rules differ in kind (drift sign vs trend-gated-by-drift vs level sign), clocks differ (weekly vs daily), and each isolates its own ingredient via a different falsification structure (stale-shift control vs macro-only control vs sham derangement + +270d stale benchmark).
genus_overlaps_non_binding.non_binding_remark_to_A1: If more than one of the three is selected, record a merge caveat in the V2 selection-freeze style (super_family: shared macro-differential genus; one survivor slot if both survive Stage-A) and note the shared single-series dependency: a WS_CBPOL live-coverage failure at the P3/Q gate would hit all selected members at once (all three already declare BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION on that gate). Selection remains A1's.

genus_overlaps_non_binding.genus: daily cross-sectional price books on the same frozen 7-pair panel
genus_overlaps_non_binding.why_not_duplicates: Opposite exploitation signs (fade outliers vs continue the LOO mean), different statistics (dispersion-gated panel z vs leave-one-out mean sign), different holding laws (zero-cross/10-bar vs fixed 5-day).
genus_overlaps_non_binding.non_binding_remark_to_A1: If both are selected they partially offset each other and share the 16:00-NY daily-bar dependency; A9-F should verify Friday flat-bar handling for both (the driver that killed four V2 proposals). Selection remains A1's.

M1.finding: Shared macro-differential genus (same BIS WS_CBPOL ingredient, three different mechanisms). Not duplicates; non-binding merge-caveat recommendation to A1 plus shared single-series live-coverage dependency at the P3/Q gate.

M2.finding: Shared daily cross-sectional price genus with opposite exploitation signs; partially offsetting if both selected; common 16:00-NY Friday flat-bar dependency for A9-F. Non-binding.

L3.finding: Cost-heavy cadence (~5,700 bps aggregate base cost) — disclosed ex ante; A9-F break-even headroom check decides.

L4.finding: ~7 months warmup_discarded truncates the scored window and F1; disclosed and gate-hardening.

L5.finding: V1-family2 adjacency is the audit's closest call; decorrelation rests on design features plus scoring-time control/incremental gates; correctly argued in the packet.

I1.finding: V2 terminal feasibility defect (16:00-NY flat bar absent on 410/2408 pair-Fridays) is structurally addressed by all six V3 packets via next-existing-bar + fail-closed NO_TRADE semantics — verified in every packet's fills/missing-bar rules.

I2.finding: Macro-conditioning quorum met: 4 of 6 proposals macro-conditioned (A4-P1, A4-P2, A5-P1, A6-P1) >= 3 required by baseline_invariants v3_sample_floors.macro_conditioning_quorum.

I3.finding: Never-scored V2 ancestors (FXFV2-A5-P1/P2, FXFV2-A6-P1/P2 — feasibility-failed, never scored, not forbidden rows) are adjacent to A5-P2/A6-P2/A6-P1 self-checks; all six V3 packets are fresh blind packets with independent designs, eligible under the V2 A7-N precedent for re-specified descendants of never-scored proposals.

I4.finding: A6 lanes disclose a broader attestation read-scope (V2 predecessor proposal packets for novelty differentiation, V1/V2 format references) than A4/A5; mechanism knowledge only, permitted by packet discipline, and more disclosing, not less.

audit_conclusion: All six proposals are genuinely new mechanisms relative to the four-row cumulative forbidden inventory: no renamed, sign-inverted, or re-clocked variant of any forbidden row exists among them; no rescue clause fires; every causal control is a preregistered single-ingredient ablation on an identical schedule (non-strawman); all outcome-blind attestations are present and specific; macro flags are consistent with the actual conditioning. NOVELTY_PASS for all six. Selection is A1's; the two MEDIUM genus overlaps are non-binding selection-time remarks.
